work_orders.title: Cold weather watch: methanol injection at max rate

notes.text: 3 PM: Methanol pump set to max for the cold snap. Scrubber dumping more often than normal today.
5 PM day shift: heat trace on the instrument rack and sensing lines checked earlier this week (runs on utility power). Discharge PSVs on all units are set at 1200 psig.

dispatch_jobs.reason: Utility power failed at station (~18:05). Instrument rack heat trace is off, possibly freezing scrubber level/dump sensing lines: scrubber level rising steadily ~0.8%/min (22% to 33.5% in 15 min, no dumping). Need restoration of utility power/heat trace and scrubber dump check, ambient -7F. Units running at 80% load, all three, on gas-engine drive.
